operation.description:
Returns a weekly aggregate of the number of additions and deletions pushed to a repository.

> [!NOTE]
> This endpoint can only be used for repositories with fewer than 10,000 commits. If the repository contains 10,000 or more commits, a 422 status code will be returned.

200.description: Returns a weekly aggregate of the number of additions and deletions pushed to a repository.

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/no_content.description: A header with no content is returned.
